Homepage \- index.html

What front end does \- basically what you see 

BACKEND \- the actual server and does what the frontend cannot such as storing data

HTML , CSS , JS all work together to complete a task, like in the screenshot above where the task was to open the korah bot. 

ASSIGNMENT 

Bold \- frontend

Home page \- **index.html**   
The backend of the homepage checks your information and makes sure your database is “loaded” in a sense. It asks for a login and has 3 backend pieces (login, loading database, and checking for a logout) 

Ask korah page \- **chat.html**  
The backend of the chat page stores past conversations. The page streams and saves answers from conversation.

Study library \- **/study/feed.html**  
Similar to homepage, every studypage starts with study/js/study-firebase-init  
**![][image6]**

Question bank \- **/sat/index.html**  
Not like other backends, more of a data center that gets college board questions. NO AI used. Has 3 pieces  
1\. The serverless function   
2\. Collegeboards API   
3\. Firebase for users data
